evidence_for.quote: Select option (a): open one narrow arrival-bridge ordinary-service B/EXPLORE comparison, HALF_RETAIN versus newly trained REPLACE.
evidence_for.why: 到达的快照在换手前已影响备用实体的动作，比较路径与预算明确。
